scope: Generation of tissue lysates from tumor samples

Tumor tissue was weighed out and processed according to the final wet weight. Reagent volumes were adjusted accordingly: 200 µL of chilled urea lysis buffer (8 M urea, 75 mM NaCl, 50 mM Tris–HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA, 2 µg/mL aprotinin, 10 µg/mL leupeptin, 1 mM PMSF) was added to each sample per 50 mg of wet weight tissue.
The supernatant was carefully removed and placed into a 2 mL conical tube, avoiding the layer of lipids that formed at the top.
